visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a yellow floral tank top and denim shorts, stands in front of a rustic wooden structure. Behind her, two individuals in elaborate zombie makeup—one with pigtails and a white dress, another in a tan robe—pose with blank expressions. The setting is an outdoor, brightly lit area with brick arches and blurred pedestrians in the background. (2) Three more performers in costume enter the frame or lean in closer to the woman. The performers have visible blood stains on their clothes and faces, representing various degrees of injury. The woman maintains a steady smile and poses with her hands clasped in front of her, looking directly into the lens. (3) The woman turns her head to face the performers, speaking to them with a polite gesture. The performer in the white dress breaks her scary persona, covering her mouth with her hand and visibly giggling. Another performer in a dark suit leans in behind them, eyes fixed on the woman. (4) The woman turns back toward the camera, laughing and smiling widely as she moves closer to the lens. The background performers remain in place, some looking down or smiling as they drop their professional character act in response to her reaction.
